caption:
The race bib is a quiet reminder that the mountain holds the final say. There are no shortcuts through terrain this dense, only the steady rhythm of gravel under tires and the patience to keep moving when the incline deepens. It is a simple, honest way to measure yourself against the landscape. When the trail is this quiet and the canopy this thick, you stop counting the kilometres and start listening to the climb.
